command: for i in $(seq 1 45); do sleep 4; WS=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d[0]["webSocketDebuggerUrl"] if d else "")'); test -n "$WS" || { echo 'WebView disappeared during scan' >&2; exit 1; }; OUT=$(WS="$WS" node -e 'const ws=new WebSocket(process.env.WS);ws.onopen=()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({id:1,method:"Runtime.evaluate",params:{expression:`JSON.stringify({text:document.body.innerText,buttons:[...document.querySelectorAll("button")].map(x=>x.innerText.trim()).filter(Boolean)})`,returnByValue:true}}));ws.onmessage=e=>{const m=JSON.parse(e.data);if(m.id===1){process.stdout.write(m.result.result.value);ws.close();}}'); printf 'SCAN_POLL_%02d=%s\n' "$i" "$(printf '%s' "$OUT" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(" | ".join(d["text"].splitlines()[-12:]))')"; if printf '%s' "$OUT" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); b=d["buttons"]; raise SystemExit(0 if any(x in ("Start scan","Scan") for x in b) and not any("Stop" in x for x in b) else 1)'; then printf '%s' "$OUT" >/tmp/lcl_scan_result.json; break; fi; done; test -s /tmp/lcl_scan_result.json; python3 -c 'import json; d=json.load(open("/tmp/lcl_scan_result.json")); print("FINAL_SCAN_TEXT_BEGIN"); print(d["text"]); print("FINAL_SCAN_TEXT_END")'
